_comment: Ingest config for sources.db — published source material the MCP server retrieves so that a
citation like 'FiM·S3E01' can be read rather than merely pointed at.
Paths point at Brian's own copies in place; nothing is copied into the repo. The two fic EPUBs
live in the repo root and are gitignored — EPUB rather than the .txt export because the .txt
loses every italic (this author sets internal monologue in them) and has no reliable chapter
list, which would have made the chapter-to-Part mapping a guess.
splitChapters names the P&K chapters that are an ontology of role-vignettes rather than a
single scene. Each marked section becomes its own Part (ch121-queens-scientist, …), because a
citation to 235,000 characters of 'chapter' is barely more precise than citing the whole fic.
mergeInto is filled from the dry run's orphan list, never inferred: the plan merges the
two-part episodes into one Part while the transcript corpus lists both halves.
